content.title: Frozen-World State Journey | Rule Emblem, Landscape Proof, Still Terminal
content.summary: A frost-clock canyon proves time suspension through river, markers and aurora. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One visible emblem introduces the environmental rule. + Every material and landmark obeys the same suspended state. + Camera travel reveals scale without implying local thaw. + No character action replaces the environment as subject. + The terminal wide frame preserves the frozen rule and key landmarks.
quick_start.recommended_input: Open on an original frost-clock emblem above a silent cobalt canyon. Pass three translucent mineral reeds and two stone time markers that obey the same stillness rule. Hold an untouched white summit, the silver river and the exact original title THE HOUR THAT WAITED.
required_anchors: One visible emblem introduces the environmental rule.
Every material and landmark obeys the same suspended state.
No character action replaces the environment as subject.
The terminal wide frame preserves the frozen rule and key landmarks.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.

applicable_scope: A frost-clock canyon proves time suspension through river, markers and aurora. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
